messages.content: You label the key moments of a motion that a Unitree G1 humanoid robot learns in a physics simulator from a video of a person doing it. The moments were found by measuring the motion; you name them so people can follow the robot's task. Describe the motion only: never address or advise the person, never judge their technique. Answer with JSON only.

content.text:
The video is sampled at 4 frames per second; it is 5.57 s long.

Key moments found in the motion (times from the start of the clip). The image shows the video's frame at each one, captioned with its number. 'Measured' is what changed most since the previous moment, by body position, in the body's own frame: left and right are the person's own sides and forward is the way their hips face. The camera may be at an angle to the body, so take sides and directions from 'measured', not from the image.
1. 1.40 s, required. Measured: right foot up, right foot forward.
2. 1.97 s, required. Measured: right foot down, right foot back.
3. 4.20 s, required. Measured: right foot up, right foot right.
4. 4.73 s, required. Measured: right foot down, right foot left.

For each moment, by its number:
- name: the pose reached at that moment, 1-4 words, lower case, e.g. 'knee chambered', 'kick extended', 'deep crouch', 'arms overhead'. Say which side when one side moves.
- description: one sentence on what the body does from the previous moment to this one.
Then the action as a whole: label (short, snake_case) and description (one sentence).

message.content: {"action": {"description": "The body performs two right-leg side kicks, returning to standing between and after them.", "label": "right_side_kicks"}, "moments": [{"description": "From standing, the body lifts the right leg sideways into full extension.", "index": 1, "name": "right kick extended"}, {"description": "From the extended kick, the body lowers the right leg back down to stand upright.", "index": 2, "name": "standing upright"}, {"description": "From standing, the body raises the right leg sideways into full extension again.", "index": 3, "name": "right kick extended"}, {"description": "From the extended kick, the body lowers the right leg to return to standing.", "index": 4, "name": "standing upright"}]}
